disposition_reason: Original ICP-MS measurements of As, Cd, Cr, Ni and Pb in 29 dried fruit samples from an open bazaar; only overall ranges and qualitative non-detects are printed as numbers.

study.design: Market survey of dried fruits with health risk assessment
study.origin: described as imported dried fruits (Conclusion); origins not stated
study.method: ICP-MS (PerkinElmer ELAN DRC-e) after closed-vessel microwave digestion with HNO3 and H2O2; standard addition calibration
study.lod_text: LOD As 0.25, Cd 0.16, Cr 0.18, Ni 0.13, Pb 0.17 µg/L; LOQ As 0.82, Cd 0.53, Cr 0.60, Ni 0.42, Pb 0.56 µg/L (Table 2)
study.qa: CRMs NIST 1573a tomato leaves and LGC7162 strawberry leaves, recoveries 98.83-100.61% (Table 4); matrix spike recoveries 97.95-104.69% (Table 3)

findings.material_label: Dried fruits (rosehip, mulberry, date, fig, apricot, blueberry, Izmir grape, apple, plum, Damson plum, black grape)
findings.locator: Results, Elemental analysis of samples, p. 401
findings.notes: Printed as a range across all 29 samples, lower end < LOD; this is the printed maximum. LOD 0.13-0.25 µg/L in digest solution (Table 2), not converted to a food basis. Per-fruit means are shown only in Fig. 2 (figure-only, not extracted). The text uses µg/kg while comparing with µg/g limits; unit as printed.
